answer.rationale: Incumbent refused a price reopen, so renew/negotiate cannot hit the 18% spend cut. Deferral is unsafe: the contract does not auto-renew and the line has no buffer (c5's month-to-month path does not apply). c2 is the only record that a primary move to this low-cost vendor cut cost sharply with fast onboarding and accurate invoicing; their quote meets the mandate alone. c1 shows incumbent integration is the stability baseline we would leave, so delivery risk is real at 94% utilization. Verify c2 before treating last year's onboarding as transferable; hold the move at standard_experiment rather than unguarded broad rollout.
